authority: Non-authoritative P1 validator vocabulary; descriptive only

rules.implementation: referent_relation_direction or pair; witness_ref required; optional instance_ref; no view-level scope; unique declaration_id
absence (subject and/or object), count (min >= 0, max >= min), join_activation (instance, gateway, unique incoming flows, min >= 1); unique rule_id
every referent, instance_ref and predicate named by a declaration or rule resolves in the context; otherwise P1_BINDING_CONTEXT_REQUIRED; no double report as P1_COVERAGE_UNDECLARED

count and join_activation need a referent/direction declaration (per incoming flow for joins); absence needs its pair or the referent in the matching direction; instance-restricted declarations cover only their instance
P1 never counts statements, never infers coverage and never evaluates a rule; evaluation belongs to lunados.lib analyze.population/v1
instance_ref resolves to a Y:identified-object:bounded-execution referent; requires_same_instance predicates: equal no finding, different FAIL, missing UNRESOLVED; scope checks unchanged
epistemic_warrant, current_authority and canonical_admission stay NOT_EVALUATED; a declaration is not proof of a surveyed state
